To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the crystal structures of two PKA holoenzymes formed by J-PkAcα and the RIα subunit show a quaternary structure different from that of other holoenzymes, and a highly dynamic J-domain region.
we solved the crystal structures of two novel PKA RIα holo-enzymes, one of which was a chimera of the DnaJ domain of DnaB1 and PKA catalytic subunit.

the structures of the chimaeric fusion PKA RIα holo-enzymes and the wild-type PKA RIα2: PKAcα2 hloenzyme are different from previously solved structures, and that the J domain is highly dynamic in the chimaeric holo-enzym.

the molecular basis of FLHCC and PKA isoform specificity.
the structure and function of the PKA regulatory subunit RIα holozymes.

the structural and dynamic features that are responsible for the isoform specificity in protein kinase A ( PKA ) and the mechanism by which the fusion chimera J-PKAc α drives fibrolamellar hepatobiliary cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the chimeric holoenzyme has the same quaternary structure as the WT RIα hloenzyme, but the chimeric J domains have different conformations and are more dynamic.
J-PKAc is not a fusion of the J domain with PKAc, but a chimeric protein that is formed by two domains of DnaJB, a J domain and a coiled-coil domain.
the chimeric and the WT RIα holi-enzymes have quatemary structures different from those of the previously solved RIβ and Rllβ holoenzymess.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we solved the structures of two PKA holoenzymes, the RIα2:WT PKAcα2 and the RIα2:DnaJB1-PKAcα chimera.

the structures of the WT RIα2: PKAcα2 and RIα2: J-PKAc α2 holoenzymes provide new insights into the molecular basis for isoform specificity in PKA signaling and the molecular mechanism underlying the oncogenic activity of the J-PKAc fusion protein in FLHCC.
the J-PKAc chimera protein has a unique quaternary structure that may be responsible for its unique biological function.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the chimeric and wild-type RIα holoenyzymes show distinct conformations, which may be due to the different dynamics of the J domain.
the chimeric J-PKAc fusion protein is a dynamic protein with a high degree of flexibility.
we have solved two new structures of the PKA holoenzyme with different isoforms of the R subunit, RIα and RIβ.
